sources.entry: Bernstein — Multi-agent orchestrator for CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and 34 more). Deterministic Python scheduler, first-class MCP server, file-based state, quality gates, cost tracking. Apache-2.0.

summary.one_liner: Bernstein is an open-source, Apache-2.0 orchestrator that runs parallel CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and 50+ others) under a deterministic, non-LLM Python scheduler with quality gates, file-based state, and verifiable run receipts.
summary.what_it_does: Decomposes a goal into tasks with roles, owned files, and completion signals, then runs them in parallel as CLI coding agents. Each coding task gets its own git worktree, and verified work is merged to main while failed tasks are retried or rerouted to another model. Workflows are declared in YAML DAGs with phases, roles, dependencies, and conditions, and the scheduler executes them as plain Python with no model deciding the next step. Non-code deliverables such as reports, datasets, or evidence packs can be completed against an artifact contract using a signed lineage receipt. The README describes an optional HMAC-chained audit log, a replay journal, and an offline run-receipt verifier built on Ed25519 signatures. It also covers cost tracking, an MCP server mode, a terminal dashboard (`bernstein live`), and a browser dashboard (`bernstein gui serve`).
use_cases: run several coding agents in parallel on one repository
orchestrate Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI on a task backlog
verify and replay what an AI agent run did
enforce approval and role policies on agent workflows
produce audit evidence packs from agent runs
mix cheap local models with cloud models in one run
how_to_run: uv tool install bernstein # or: pipx install bernstein
bernstein doctor # checks a CLI agent is installed and authenticated
bernstein -g "fix the failing test in tests/test_foo.py"
stack: uv / pipx / pip / brew / dnf / npm / Docker install paths
notable: Deterministic scheduler with no LLM in the coordination loop, so runs can be replayed and compared
Per-task git worktree isolation behind merge gates
Signed run receipts that can be verified offline with a single command
Adapters for more than 50 CLI agents plus a generic --prompt wrapper
Air-gap install profile and wheelhouse guide
caveats: Self-described as beta and solo-maintained; minor versions may change interfaces
Some features are experimental or not yet shipped, including cloud execution on Cloudflare Workers and the volunteer `autopilot` runner, which refuses to run until a TaskSource is implemented
Audit-chain verification only works when the run was started with BERNSTEIN_AUDIT=1, a compliance preset, or --audit
keywords: coordinate ai agents on one repo
